For visitors

Book ahead: register on the Y's Road site, pay the ¥200 fee, then fill in the Google Form for that date. Ten riders max. Helmet and gloves required or you are turned away; bring lights, a bell and a spare tube. Called off if the 5 pm forecast the day before gives over 50% rain for 6 am to noon.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Each ride is rated one to five stars; climbs at your own pace, and the leaders wait so nobody ends up riding alone. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @ysroad.osaka the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the ワイズロード大阪本館 サンデーライド group ride

ワイズロード大阪本館 サンデーライド is a road group ride in Osaka, Japan. It rolls some Sundays at 8:30 am local time from Y's Road Osaka Honkan (front entrance).

The Osaka flagship store's Sunday lunch ride: up to ten riders leave the shop in Senba at 8:30 for about 70 km, often south on the Yamato River cycling road toward Nara or Tondabayashi, with a café lunch at the turn. Each ride carries a star rating so you can pick your level. Staff lead it.
